errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart, but the description incorrectly refers to the bars as vertical.
The text labels for the categories are positioned to the left of the bars, not above them.
The description misspells the category label. The correct spelling in the figure is "време за подготовка на иновационни методи".
The bar corresponding to "достъп до примери за успешно приложение на иновации" reaches approximately 48%, not 45%. The approximation is an underestimation.

errors.text_span: всички са представени с еднакъв стил и размер
errors.evidence: The statement that all bars have the same size ("размер") is incorrect and confusing, as their length is the variable that represents the data. The intended meaning was likely 'thickness', but the wording is ambiguous.
